help.en: Off leaves every behavior exactly as before. On: holding a DualHook weapon (别离残钩) with shachi at or above hook_counter_shachi turns a black-flash (PowerAttack) check into block-and-triangle counter instead of dodge or parry.
help.zh-Hans: 关闭时行为与升级前完全一致。开启后：手持别离残钩（DualHook）且杀气不低于 hook_counter_shachi 时，黑光（PowerAttack）判定改为「按住格挡＋三角形」反制，不再按黑闪设置闪避/弹反。

help.en: Shachi percentage the hook counter needs. Read only while hook_counter is on; below it a black flash still follows the black_flash setting.
help.zh-Hans: 别离残钩反制所需的杀气百分比。仅在 hook_counter 开启时读取；低于该值时黑光仍按 black_flash 设置处理。

help.en: Experimental; off leaves every behavior exactly as before. On: while an enemy with a blue shield (Shield > 0) stands within shield_counter_range, the mod switches to the DualHook and counters that enemy's blockable attacks, and will not switch the hook away while such an enemy is near.
help.zh-Hans: 测试中；关闭时行为与升级前完全一致。开启后：shield_counter_range 公分内存在带蓝色护盾（Shield > 0）的敌人时，自动切到别离残钩并对它的可格挡攻击放反制；附近有这种敌人时不会把别离残钩切走。

help.en: Scan radius in centimeters for blue-shielded enemies. Read only while shield_counter is on; wider ranges also react to enemies you are not fighting yet.
help.zh-Hans: 扫描蓝色护盾敌人的半径（公分）。仅在 shield_counter 开启时读取；范围越大越容易对尚未交手的敌人反应。
